help.title: Help
help.intro: Answers to the most common questions about apps, deployments and access data.
steps: Open the catalog and choose an app.
Give the deployment a name. If the app works with teams, assign the students to them.
Check the settings. The defaults are usually enough; only values without a default must be entered.
Review the summary and start the deployment.
Follow the progress under “Deployments”. Students find their access data under “My environments”.
problems: The deployment does not start? Check whether your quota is used up.
The deployment failed? Open it under “Deployments” and read the log.
A Windows or VM app does not start? Store your OpenStack credentials first.
